protocol.model: y = 1 + 0.5*x1 + N(0,1); x1..x64 independent N(0,1), doubles; prefix RHS; intercept; default IID VCE; no weights or FE
protocol.timing: complete quiet command via monotonic command-clock; data load/generation, validation and processor changes excluded
protocol.interference: ordinary desktop activity retained; no exclusions or retries; no concurrent builds/tests; fixed schedule, 1200-second process limit
protocol.oracle: independent SciPy unpivoted Householder QR of [1,X64,y], nested triangular solves and covariance
protocol.candidate: unchanged published dist plugin; no candidate development/activation; descriptive comparison, not qualify.py acceptance
protocol.random_generator: NumPy 1.26.4 default_rng(739391), PCG64; standard_normal((1000000,64)) in C order, then standard_normal(1000000) noise
protocol.actual_process_limit: Direct Stata batch run completed in under four minutes; initial Python supervisors stalled before fits and were terminated. The planned five repetitions were unchanged.

science.rank_convention: fereg e(rank)=k and e(df_a)=1 for the global intercept; regress e(rank)=k+1; compare full design rank=N-df_r

preflight.repair: Initial check incorrectly assumed fereg e(rank)=k+1, e(df_a)=0; corrected for absorbed global intercept. Same data, binary, 420-call schedule and five repetitions retained. One regress warm-up completed and one fereg warm-up stopped at assertion. Python-launched sandbox wrappers stalled before work and were terminated; the fixed benchmark then ran directly once. No measured samples excluded or repeated.

reproduction.prepare_source:
import os
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']='1'
os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS']='1'
import hashlib,json,random
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.linalg import qr,solve_triangular
root=Path.cwd(); work=Path('WORK_DIRECTORY')
seed=739391; n=1_000_000; ks=[1,2,4,8,16,32,64]; ts=[1,2,4,8,16]
rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
x=rng.standard_normal((n,64)); y=1+.5*x[:,0]+rng.standard_normal(n)
frame=pd.DataFrame(x,columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(1,65)]); frame.insert(0,'y',y)
frame.to_stata(work/'data.dta',write_index=False,version=118)
print('data saved',flush=True)
a=np.empty((n,66),order='F'); a[:,0]=1; a[:,1:65]=x; a[:,65]=y
r=qr(a,mode='r',overwrite_a=True,check_finite=False)[0][:66,:]
refs={}
for k in ks:
 p=k+1; rr=r[:p,:p]; b=solve_triangular(rr,r[:p,65]); rss=float(r[p:,65]@r[p:,65]); inv=solve_triangular(rr,np.eye(p)); v=rss/(n-p)*(inv@inv.T); order=list(range(1,p))+[0]
 refs[k]={'b':b[order].tolist(),'V':v[np.ix_(order,order)].tolist(),'rss':rss,'N':n,'rank':p,'df_r':n-p}
(work/'reference.json').write_text(json.dumps(refs))

version 19
clear all
set more off
set varabbrev off
set linesize 255
adopath ++ "REPOSITORY_DIRECTORY/stata"
adopath ++ "REPOSITORY_DIRECTORY/dist"
quietly findfile fereg_macos.plugin
assert r(fn) == "REPOSITORY_DIRECTORY/dist/fereg_macos.plugin"
program _clock, plugin using("WORK_DIRECTORY/command-clock.plugin")
quietly use "WORK_DIRECTORY/data.dta", clear
mata: ft=fopen("WORK_DIRECTORY/timings.tsv","w"); fs=fopen("WORK_DIRECTORY/science.tsv","w")
program _run
    args arm k threads repetition
    local processors=min(`threads',c(processors_lic),c(processors_mach))
    set processors `processors'
    local options
    if "`arm'" == "fereg" local options , threads(`threads')
    tempname secs res
    scalar `secs'=.
    scalar `res'=.
    plugin call _clock, start
    capture noisily quietly `arm' y x1-x`k' `options'
    local rc=_rc
    plugin call _clock, stop `secs' `res'
    if `rc' exit `rc'
    assert scalar(`secs')>0 & scalar(`secs')<120
    assert scalar(`res')>0 & scalar(`res')<=0.0000005
    assert e(N)==1000000 & e(df_r)==1000000-`k'-1
    local native=.
    local input=.
    local preflight=.
    local total=.
    local workers=`processors'
    if "`arm'"=="fereg" {
        local native=el(e(fereg_runtime),20,2)
        local input=el(e(fereg_runtime),19,2)
        local preflight=el(e(fereg_runtime),18,2)
        local total=el(e(fereg_runtime),21,2)
        local workers=e(fereg_threads)
        assert `workers'==`threads'
        assert e(df_a)==1
    }
    mata: fput(ft, "`arm' `k' `threads' `processors' `repetition' "+strofreal(st_numscalar("`secs'"),"%24.17g")+" `native' `input' `preflight' `total' `workers'"); fput(fs,"`arm' `k' `threads' `repetition' "+invtokens(strofreal((st_matrix("e(b)"),vec(st_matrix("e(V)"))',st_numscalar("e(rss)"),st_numscalar("e(N)"),st_numscalar("e(N)")-st_numscalar("e(df_r)"),st_numscalar("e(df_r)")),"%24.17g")))
    display "DONE `arm' k=`k' t=`threads' rep=`repetition' secs=" scalar(`secs')
end
